title: Global Optimality for Constrained Exploration via Penalty Regularization: the smoothed-entropy regularity and dual translation bundle (Lemma 10.3)
author:
Florian
Wolf, Ilyas Fatkhullin, Niao He
work: Global Optimality for Constrained Exploration via Penalty Regularization
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the paper's smoothed-entropy regularity and dual-translation lemma, printed as Lemma C.3 at source0.tex lines 2454-2534 and delivered with the paper's own complete proof (lines 2535-2586). The statement bundles, for the smoothed entropy surrogate with its smoothing parameter, the concavity of the surrogate, its exact gradient and diagonal Hessian, the three regularity inequalities with explicit constants, an approximation bound against the true entropy, and the translation of the penalty suboptimality into a dual lower bound and a two-sided optimality-gap estimate. The proof is the paper's own: it differentiates the surrogate coordinatewise, bounds the Hessian entries to obtain the smoothness constants with the mean value theorem, proves the approximation bound through a concavity argument on an auxiliary function of one variable, and then uses strong duality together with the bounded surrogate gap and Jensen's inequality to convert the penalty guarantee into the constraint and objective translations. This is the regularity bundle on which the paper's globally optimal penalty rates for constrained exploration rest, and it is the paper's own estimate-tracking argument rather than a qualifying-examination computation, so the unit is H2.
